crossRefs.note: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
translations.bsb: Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.
translations.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
translations.asv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.
